data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 justifies sustaining the ritual flags by claiming that SRC_007 and SRC_009 probe DISTINCT (orthogonal) dimensions—honesty of claims vs. magnitude above floor—and that 'orthogonal failures on the same artifact are a stronger signal.' But this logic is self-undermining for adjudication rigor: genuinely orthogonal failures address independent aspects, so their convergence does not warrant elevating confidence beyond the independent evidentiary value of each. The target conflates orthogonality with corroboration. Independent, non-overlapping dimensions by definition do not reinforce one another; treating them as a 'stronger signal' conflates multi-dimensional coverage with multi-critic agreement on the same dimension, which is the scenario where convergence genuinely elevates confidence.
